result_summary: 514 PASS and 0 FAIL. New coverage verifies command parsing (trim, case-insensitivity, dot-prefix alias .lshp, args, unknown command), WeChat first-item-type gate, executor whitelist mapping to injected mocks, IPC request/response framing, and CLI runner exit codes.
limitations: Executor mapping is exercised with mock services; real GUI side effects (open panel, blackout window, login item) are covered at the boundary only.
The raw POSIX socket client path is validated by runtime E2E rather than the unit suite.
